'hump of camel' MBh., 'glans penis' Suśr., 'clitoris' lex., 'fleshy excrescence on a goat's neck' VarBr̥S., 'thyroid cartilege (= kaṇṭhamaṇi-), wrist' lex., maṇika- m.
